mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 233 signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting market anticipation of rate hikes and short-term equity discount compression, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not cross 233 within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) exceeding their respective thresholds signal a robust economic expansion, reducing uncertainty and driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite both proxies exceeding their thresholds, or one proxy fails to meet its threshold.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained low UNRATE (<7.0%) coupled with persistently low FEDFUNDS (<0.15%) signals strong labor market health and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in such regimes, or triggers not met.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 0.15 signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing growth expectations and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not cross 0.15 within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: High employment (PAYEMS) coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, fostering investor confidence and positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite both proxies meeting their thresholds, or one proxy fails to meet its threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (demand) over time indicates growing economic activity, reducing risk premiums and driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1, or the trend reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in INDPRO above 99.0 signals a robust supply-side recovery from a shock, fostering market optimism and driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in such recovery periods, or trigger conditions not met.
